section.title: Reminding a borrower before a due date
section.scenario: A town library's app emails borrowers two days before a book is due. The reminder went out to every branch last spring, and the team's release notes record that the old no-reminder behavior was retired from the product plan. The due_date_reminders flag is on in every environment, and the admin control that could turn it off was removed. The flag service is still in the codebase for other features and reads from the app's own database.
section.question: Which piece should send the reminder, and which stated fact decides it?
section.piece_b:
class LoanReminder
  def initialize(loan)
    @loan = loan
  end

  def deliver
    return unless @loan.due_on == 2.days.from_now.to_date

    LoanMailer.due_soon(@loan).deliver_later
  end
end
